sources.title: Wikipedia: Paracelsus
sources.description: Swiss physician, philosopher, theologian, and alchemist (c. 1493 – 1541)

notes.text: Theophrastus Bombast von Hohenheim, known as Paracelsus, was a Swiss physician, alchemist, lay theologian, and philosopher of the German Renaissance.
Paracelsus is remembered as a physician connected with Switzerland.
Paracelsus's recorded life dates place this profile around 1493-1541.
Paracelsus is grouped with Science, Math & Technology in the People Library.
Paracelsus's profile connects a short Fact to a wider Switzerland historical setting.
